seo.description_paragraph: Abena is a name of Akan (Ghana) origin meaning “Born on Tuesday”. An Akan day-name from Ghana, given to a girl born on Tuesday. faq.q: What does the name Abena mean?
faq.a: Abena means “Born on Tuesday”.

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Abena?
faq.a: Abena is of Akan (Ghana) origin.

faq.q: What language does the name Abena come from?
faq.a: Abena is used in Akan, English.

faq.q: Is Abena a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Abena is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Abena pronounced?
faq.a: Abena is pronounced ah-BEH-nah.

faq.q: How is Abena written in Latin?
faq.a: Abena is written Abena in Latin script.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Abena?
faq.a: The root of Abena is Akan day-name (Kwabena/Abena) for a female born on Tuesday.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Abena?
faq.a: An Akan day-name from Ghana, given to a girl born on Tuesday. It is part of the Akan system of naming children after the day of the week.

faq.q: Does Abena appear in the Bible?
faq.a: No. The name does not occur in the Bible. It is an Akan day-name.

faq.q: Is Abena a Biblical name?
faq.a: No. Abena is not a Biblical personal name; it is of Akan (Ghana) origin.

faq.q: Does Abena occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the Old Testament.

faq.q: Does Abena occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the New Testament.

faq.q: Is Abena associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Abena.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Abena verified?
faq.a: The meaning “Born on Tuesday” is supported by Akan (Ghanaian) day-name tradition. Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Abena?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abena total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is traditionally associated with change, freedom and adaptability. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Abena?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Kwabena (male form).

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Abena?
faq.a: Abena is transliterated as Abena.

faq.q: How many syllables does Abena have?
faq.a: Abena has 3 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Abena?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Abena is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “Born on Tuesday”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Abena used today?
faq.a: Abena circulates chiefly in Akan, English naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
